tool_input.command: cat data/schema.md; echo "=== INITIAL ==="; head -5 data/initial_export.csv; echo "=== NEW ==="; head -5 data/reload/new_export.csv; echo "=== counts ==="; wc -l data/initial_export.csv data/reload/new_export.csv
hops fg create --help 2>&1 | tail -50; echo "===INSERT==="; hops fg insert --help 2>&1 | tail -40

hops fg create customerscd488e --version 1 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string,name:string,balance_eur:double,updated_at:bigint" --description "Customers initial schema" --quiet --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert customerscd488e --version 1 --file data/initial_export.csv --quiet --json 2>&1 | tail -25

hops fg create customerscd488e --version 2 --primary-key row_id --event-time updated_at --features "row_id:string,full_name:string,balance:double,currency:string,updated_at:bigint" --online --description "Customers new schema (reload)" --quiet --json 2>&1 | tail -20
hops fg insert customerscd488e --version 2 --file data/reload/new_export.csv --quiet --json 2>&1 | tail -25

echo "=== v2 info ==="; hops fg info customerscd488e --version 2 --quiet --json 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|compatibility\|pip install\|Logged in" | head -40; echo "=== v2 preview ==="; hops fg preview customerscd488e --version 2 --n 5 --quiet --json 2>&1 | grep -v "INFO:\|UserWarning\|compatibility\|pip install\|Logged in" | head -40
